activity.notes: ATLAS uses c.400 BCE as an explicitly approximate representative intellectual-activity point for Pāṇini in Gandhara. Encyclopaedia Iranica notes that Pāṇini used the name Gandhara around 400 BCE, probably hailed from the region, and that Gandhara was an Achaemenid Persian province. This does not claim an exact birth, death, or composition date.

sources.title: GANDHĀRA — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Encyclopaedia Iranica identifies Gandhara as an Achaemenid province and states that around 400 BCE the grammarian Pāṇini used the name and probably hailed from Gandhara.
